▸ Learning Data 10

• Read the meaning of Data 10.
• Copy every worked example into your book.
• Then solve the Try this questions without looking.

▸ Data 10

Teach
• Use objects, drawings, or place value to understand Data 10.
• Write each step. Box the final answer.

Worked example
• Model question on Data 10: write the question.
• Step 1: …
• Step 2: …
• Answer: …
• (Your teacher/parent can replace this with the class example.)

Try this
• Invent 3 Data 10 questions using Kenyan shillings, metres, or classroom counts.
• Solve all three and show working.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Show working for one Data 10 question.
• Check with a second method.

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Solve 8 practice questions on Data 10.
2. Mark and correct mistakes.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a revision sheet for Data 10 with 5 worked examples.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Show working.
• Check every answer.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
